preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
The number of friends N is between 1 and 1,000,000,000, inclusive.
The number of slices per pizza K is between 1 and 1,000,000,000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of pizzas Chef has to buy to share all the slices among his friends so that none of his friends gets sad.
